header: "Download as PDF" for an EDS reply: builds the document model, draws it with the PDF library and hands the file to the browser. I load the PDF library, the painter and the fonts HERE, on the click (dynamic import), so nobody pays for them until they ask for a PDF.

doc: Makes the PDF of a reply and returns it as a file blob with its suggested name. I throw PdfNothingToDownload for an empty or error reply.
